item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene marries conservative commentator Brian Glenn
item.description: Former U.S. Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene married conservative media personality Brian Glenn on Tuesday in Las Vegas after announcing their engagement in December.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Florida congressional candidate arrested and charged with obstruction in Parrish: MCSO
item.description: The Manatee County Sheriff's Office (MCSO) said a man running for Congress was arrested and charged with obstruction in Parrish on Tuesday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] AI shopping assistants growing in popularity, but consumer trust still lags
item.description: Consumers are increasingly using AI shopping assistants, but most still verify recommendations before buying — especially for costly or health-related purchases.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News to Know for July 30, 2026
item.description: Synthetic opioid 7-OH driving surge in Florida Poison Center calls. Plus, judge clears SPCA Tampa Bay in Waddles the pig case.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] St. Pete gym owner Tiffany Walling is back in business after battle with breast cancer
item.description: St. Pete gym owner Tiffany Walling is back in business after a battle with breast cancer. Her Standard Procedure gym caters to all, including young moms on the go.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco County Schools limits screen time for students
item.description: Pasco County students will be spending less time in front of screens this school year. New District guidelines cap passive screen time for students in kindergarten through 12 grade.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Lakeland cockfighting arrest: Traffic stop leads to charges against Plant City man
item.description: A routine traffic stop in Lakeland on Monday led to the arrest of a 38-year-old man after officers said they discovered marijuana and gear used for organized cockfighting inside his vehicle.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Why Hernando County might close its largest library
item.description: Hernando County commissioners face a consequential budget decision Thursday: whether to reopen the West Hernando Branch Library or allow a temporary closure caused by air-conditioning problems to become permanent.
